values.raw: Optional: The geometric tolerances applied to datum features D, E, F, G, H, and J are not required for the test case. However, the geometric tolerances applied to datum features E, F, H, and J help to legitimize the modifiers applied to the datum feature references in the geometric tolerances related to D|E|F and G|H|J. The tolerances are mainly important in calculating the MMC virtual condition or LMC virtual condition of the datum feature simulators for E, F, H, and J. The geometric tolerances specified at LMC for datum features H and J are particularly important, as they also make it easier to understand the LMC virtual condition of the datum features, as a geometric tolerance specified at LMC changes Rule #1 to require perfect form at LMC instead of MMC.
